source_dataset: FSD50K collection annotations cross-referenced with released dev/eval sets

selection_rule_after_human_audit: Use all preselected candidates that receive human_audit_status=ELIGIBLE. Freeze is allowed only if >=20 unique source groups remain and both target classes are represented. Model outputs are never consulted when deciding eligibility.
